name: variants_per_template
source_sql: SELECT product_tmpl_id AS "productTmplId", COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_product GROUP BY product_tmpl_id ORDER BY product_tmpl_id

name: variant_by_barcode
source_sql: SELECT id AS "_id", barcode, default_code AS "defaultCode", product_tmpl_id AS "productTmplId", active FROM product_product WHERE barcode IS NOT NULL ORDER BY barcode

name: active_templates_catalog
source_sql: SELECT id AS "_id", name->>'en_US' AS name, list_price AS "listPrice", categ_id AS "categId", uom_id AS "uomId", is_favorite AS "isFavorite" FROM product_template WHERE active IS TRUE ORDER BY id

name: values_per_attribute_line
source_sql: SELECT attribute_line_id AS "attributeLineId", COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_template_attribute_value GROUP BY attribute_line_id ORDER BY attribute_line_id

name: line_value_ids_embed_size
source_sql: SELECT product_template_attribute_line_id AS "_id", COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_attribute_value_product_template_attribute_line_rel GROUP BY product_template_attribute_line_id ORDER BY product_template_attribute_line_id

name: packagings_by_barcode
source_sql: SELECT id AS "_id", product_id AS "productId", uom_id AS "uomId", barcode FROM product_uom ORDER BY barcode

name: documents_by_sequence
source_sql: SELECT id AS "_id", ir_attachment_id AS "irAttachmentId", sequence, active FROM product_document ORDER BY sequence, id
